final saved = <int>[];
Future<void> save(int item) async {
  saved.add(item);
}

Future<void> main() async {
  final groups = [
    [1, 2],
    [3, 4],
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
    for (final item in groups[i]) {
      await save(item);
    }
    if (saved.length > 10) break;
  }
  if (saved.join(',') != '1,2,3,4') throw StateError('$saved');
  print('saved=$saved');
}
